DuckDB attaches a Unity Catalog catalog with its `unity_catalog` extension and
works with the Delta files through its `delta` extension. Iceberg tables go
through the Iceberg REST API.

## Set it up

- [Use DuckDB with Unity Catalog](../../how-to/duckdb/index.md)
